# Preview: the task file on stdout and one note per recognized field on
# stderr, checked against the immutable corpus in skycompat/testdata/import
# of the root module.

skycompat import --shell /bin/sh --workdir-ref $IMPORT/workdir-ref.json --output out --target local --allow-drop name $IMPORT/local/task.yaml
cmp stdout $IMPORT/local/task.json
cmp stderr $IMPORT/local/task.notes

skycompat import --shell /bin/sh --workdir-ref $IMPORT/workdir-ref.json --output out --allow-drop name $IMPORT/kubernetes/task.yaml
cmp stdout $IMPORT/kubernetes/task.json
cmp stderr $IMPORT/kubernetes/task.notes

skycompat import --shell /bin/bash --target gpu --timeout-seconds 3600 $IMPORT/accept/resources.yaml
cmp stdout $IMPORT/accept/resources.json
cmp stderr $IMPORT/accept/resources.notes

skycompat import --shell /bin/sh --allow-drop name --allow-drop _user_specified_yaml $IMPORT/accept/defaults.yaml
cmp stdout $IMPORT/accept/defaults.json
cmp stderr $IMPORT/accept/defaults.notes

skycompat import --shell /bin/sh $IMPORT/accept/multiline.yaml
cmp stdout $IMPORT/accept/multiline.json
cmp stderr $IMPORT/accept/multiline.notes

# Standard input, Python boolean coercion and an explicit override for a
# null environment value.
stdin env.yaml
skycompat import --shell /bin/sh --env TOKEN=explicit -
cmp stdout env.json
cmp stderr env.notes

# Characters YAML would reject or fold are escaped.
skycompat import --shell /bin/sh exotic.yaml
cmp stdout exotic.json

# The FROZEN-1 literal form of the same case: raw U+2028 and U+FEFF inside
# the quoted scalar. Expected bytes are UNRUN, derived from yaml.v3 v3.0.1
# source: a raw U+2028 is a line break that a double-quoted scalar keeps
# verbatim (only a leading LF folds to a space), and a raw U+FEFF is an
# ordinary character. The actual decode is asserted by cmp.
skycompat import --shell /bin/sh exotic-literal.yaml
cmp stdout exotic-literal.json

-- env.yaml --
run: echo "$GREETING $TOKEN"
envs:
  GREETING: true
  TOKEN: null
-- env.json --
{
  "argv": ["/bin/sh", "-c", "echo \"$GREETING $TOKEN\""],
  "env": {
    "GREETING": "True",
    "TOKEN": "explicit"
  }
}
-- env.notes --
run	lowered	argv is shell -c text
envs	lowered	environment
-- exotic.yaml --
run: "a\u2028b\x85c\ufeffd\x7fe\x01f\x1bg\th — ✓ 🚀"
-- exotic.json --
{
  "argv": ["/bin/sh", "-c", "a\u2028b\u0085c\ufeffd\u007fe\u0001f\u001bg\th — ✓ 🚀"]
}
-- exotic-literal.yaml --
run: "a b\x85c﻿d\x7fe\x01f\x1bg\th — ✓ 🚀"
-- exotic-literal.json --
{
  "argv": ["/bin/sh", "-c", "a\u2028b\u0085c\ufeffd\u007fe\u0001f\u001bg\th — ✓ 🚀"]
}
